entries.name: TARGET_IMPRINTED_RESIDUAL_COMPLETION
entries.applies_when: The stated target requires an exact global zero-residual or zero-forcing identity, or an equivalent exact autonomous closure.
blacklisted_pattern: Prescribe or construct a candidate already carrying the desired endpoint behavior.
Define the residual, correction, forcing, or defect from that candidate so the modified equation holds.
Prove only that the repair term is small, decaying, flat at a selected point, zero to high order, or negligible after a selected limiting/rescaling procedure.
Treat that weaker property as if the original exact zero-residual target had been derived or as evidence of endogenous autonomous instability.
entries.allowed_boundary: If the theorem explicitly existentially quantifies the residual/forcing/correction and permits it to be chosen, residual completion is not automatically invalid for that theorem. It carries no authority toward a stronger zero-residual target without a separate bridge theorem proving the exact zero identity.
